subject: Temporary COI / Naming Exception and routing playbook for Order Form

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brookfieldbrokers.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: COI: temporary naming + endorsement ask for Order Form

Hi Ben —

We’re close to signing the order form but legal is asking for the COI to name two specific entities as Additional Insureds and to include endorsement language for waiver-of-subrogation. Our broker (Tom) says the carrier needs a short time window to issue the endorsement. Can Redwood accept a temporary COI naming Redwood Holdings, Inc. and Redwood Inference, Inc. with the full endorsement to follow within 10 business days? I attached ACME’s COI request for reference.

We also attached the redlines we received on the MSA — a handful of items are still outstanding but the insurance piece is the gating item for procurement. Appreciate quick confirmation so we can move to signature.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Cloud Services

Attachments: ACME_COI_Request.pdf, MSA_Redline_v3.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@acme.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brookfieldbrokers.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: COI: temporary naming + endorsement ask for Order Form

Hi Olivia / Tom —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. We’re OK with a staged delivery as long as: 1) the temporary COI lists the two additional insured entities exactly as you specified, 2) it shows limits that meet the Order Form minimums (see MSA §7.2), and 3) the carrier confirms the endorsement will be issued within 10 business days after signature.

I’m looping in Laura from Legal to confirm the exact naming convention and whether we need an MSA amendment or a written procurement exception documented in the contract folder. Laura — can you confirm we don’t need a signed endorsement before countersignature for this account, assuming the carrier confirmation is provided and we receive the final endorsement within the 10-business-day window?

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@acme.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: COI: temporary naming + endorsement ask for Order Form

Ben / Olivia —

I reviewed ACME’s COI request and our MSA. We can approve a temporary COI exception for signature under the following conditions: 

- Temporary COI includes exact entity names: "Redwood Holdings, Inc." and "Redwood Inference, Inc." (no abbreviations).
- COI must show the required limits: Commercial General Liability (primary) $2,000,000 each occurrence / $4,000,000 aggregate; Auto $1,000,000; Professional Liability $2,000,000 (or waiver by Risk).
- Carrier provides a dated email from the broker confirming endorsement issuance within 10 business days after countersignature, and attaches a PDF of the policy declaration page.
- Final endorsement and updated COI must be uploaded to our contract folder; if the endorsement is not received in 10 business days, Redwood reserves the right to suspend onboarding and/or invoke remedial rights in the MSA.

That should satisfy Legal + Risk. Chloe from Risk — please confirm you’re aligned on limits and the suspension language. If you’re good, Ben please add a short procurement exception clause to the DocuSign comments and we’ll proceed.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Procurement
Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: COI: temporary naming + endorsement ask for Order Form

All —

Confirmed on limits and the 10-business-day handling. Two operational notes from Risk: 

1) Please ensure the temporary COI states "Additional Insured: Redwood Holdings, Inc.; Redwood Inference, Inc." exactly (comma-separated). We occasionally see carrier templates that say "Redwood Inc." which we cannot accept.
2) For tracking, Tom — please include the carrier name, policy number, and the expected endorsement issuance date in your broker confirmation email so we can reconcile quickly.

Once we receive the broker confirmation email, Risk will mark the account as "insurance-verified (temporary)" in the contract tracker and trigger onboarding tasks.

Chloe Martin
Risk Manager
Redwood Inference
